messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting a playbook for a vector-dimension upgrade and the associated rerank edge cases. Need PRD-level acceptance criteria + rollout plan. Starting notes here.
Sam: Which customers are driving this? Is this a single migration or multiple parallel requests?
Maya: Two asks so far: FinSys wants 1536 dim embeddings for richer finance signals. SearchCo wants a partial bump (768 -> 1024) only for rerank subset. Both care about no visible quality regressions.
Priya: Do we require zero-downtime? Can we serve both dims simultaneously (dual-index) or do we want an on-the-fly projection layer?
Alex: Option A: dual-index + rewrite consumer to pick index. Option B: projection layer that maps 1536->768 or 768->1024 (learned linear proj). Tradeoffs: storage vs inference CPU/latency.
Juan: Watch out for normalization differences — L2 vs cosine scaling changes reorder rerank. Need deterministic normalization step in the serving path and eval harness to catch shifts.
Maya: Draft acceptance criteria (high level):
- Functional: requests with the old dim must return compatible similarity ranks within acceptance thresholds.
- Stability: Top-5 overlap >= 95% on a held-out rerank eval set for both customers.
- Perf: p95 latency delta <= 15ms for rerank calls; end-to-end p95 <= 50ms for typical flows.
- Cost: serving cost increase <= 20% at steady state for customer tiers.
- Safety: fallbacks + rollback path tested.

Test checklist (to include in PRD):
```
1) Offline eval: compute top-k overlap and delta-MRR across 10k queries
2) Load test: synthetic 10k qps against dual-index and projection paths
3) A/B canary: 1% -> 10% -> 50% rollout with automated rollback on quality drift
4) SDK: client flag to pin to "old" or "new" embeddings
```
Priya: Rollout idea: (1) Dual-index write (both dims) -> (2) Canaries read from new index for subset -> (3) If stable, switch rerank route -> (4) Stop writes to old index after a deprecation window.
Erin: How do batch semantics work when requests in the same batch have mixed dims? We need a deterministic policy: either coalesce by shape (dispatch separate batches) or convert at ingress.
Sam: Agree. Performance budget: p95 batching overhead for conversions must be < 5ms; memory overhead bounded. Quality guard: maintain top-5 stability >=95% for rerank eval set. Also define rollback triggers: >3% drop in NDCG or >10% latency regression.
Alex: Sketch of config for runtime routing:
```
routing:
  - match: requester.customer == "FinSys"
    prefer_index: "embeddings-1536-v2"
  - default:
    prefer_index: "embeddings-768-v1"
conversion:
  enable_projection: true
  method: "linear-learned"
  max_extra_latency_ms: 8
```
Juan: Edge cases to add to PRD:
- Normalization method changes (L2 vs per-dim scaling)
- Quantization artifacts when converting dims (int8 vs fp16)
- OOV/rare tokens shifting embedding distribution
- Batched partial requests where some vectors are missing components
- Clients that store raw vectors locally and don't request fresh ones

EmbedBot: Eval job queued: "embed-stability-upgrade-180512" (queued by Maya). Result ETA: ~3h. :gear:
Juan: Also add synthetic-noise test: add gaussian noise to new-dim vectors, recompute rerank, ensure robustness to small perturbations.
Maya: Action items:
- Priya & Alex: draft dual-index write + projection implementation plan (PRD + rough effort) — owner: Priya — due EOD Tue
- Juan: add normalization + quantization test cases to eval harness — owner: Juan — due Fri
- Erin: define batching dispatch policy and perf microbenchmarks — owner: Erin — due Wed
- Sam: draft customer comms + rollback play for FinSys & SearchCo — owner: Sam — due Thu

Thanks all — I'll pull these into a single PRD and ping for review once initial sections are filled. :thumbsup:
